label: Ocho Rios, St. Ann & St. Mary
note: Start with western St. Ann, Ocho Rios and its hinterland, or the St. Mary coast and hills. Choose one branch before adding stops.

label: Montego Bay, Falmouth & Trelawny
note: Separate downtown Montego Bay, the Rose Hall coast, Falmouth and inland outings. This is a regional collection, not one day’s circuit.

label: Negril, Hanover & Western Jamaica
note: Negril beach and cliffs, Hanover towns and western inland outings. South Coast stops such as Border also have their own regional tag.

label: Port Antonio & Portland
note: Choose a coastal branch or an inland river/community day. Blue Mountain routes can also appear in the mountain region.

label: Kingston & the Blue Mountains
note: Keep city museums and music separate from a mountain day. Mountain routes may cross Portland and St. Thomas.

label: St. Thomas & the Southeast
note: Morant Bay, Bath and southeastern communities. A mountain trail and a coastal visit require different arrangements.

label: South Coast & St. Elizabeth
note: Black River, Treasure Beach and southern coastal stops. Border spans St. Elizabeth and Westmoreland; it is not a Negril beach stop.

label: Central Jamaica & the Interior
note: Mandeville, Spanish Town and central parish routes. Pick a town or branch; this broad region is not a short driving loop.
